MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing this day.
Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Ron Sinclaire.
Joyce Frederick, Esq. for Plaintiff: Michael Quesada, also present, was sworn and examined.
After hearing the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendant: Christine Groves as follows:
Damages $376,487.63
Costs $416.53, for a total of $376,904.16
($67,457.63 of the Judgment is awarded to City and County of San Francisco for reimbursement of medical lien)
Judgment signed in open court.
